claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another won Best Supporting Actor at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another is a political drama.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio.
Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another competed against Ryan Coogler's Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards
